scope: Full-text target-precondition annotation for newly generated reflections in shared calibration
interpretation_rules: Ordinary heat-in-microwave wording alone does not assert put-before-heat.
A prior pickup followed by an explicit put/close/heat sequence is E, not automatically B.
B requires an additional heating-time inventory recommendation; ambiguous timing remains A.
Other appliance errors and skipping required heating do not make U globally correct.
Testing an already enclosed different object without a clear target prerequisite is A.
Rejected historical errors are not endorsed recommendations.
